metrics.Total Transaction Amount: Sum of amount in the Live merchant transaction store; all recorded statuses, no recent-row or table-page limit.
metrics.Total NUERS Charged: Negative signed sum of posted fee entries in the merchant wallet ledger. Actual historical rates, not transaction count multiplied by current pricing.
metrics.Total Merchant Wallet: Sum of current available_centavos across merchant wallets.
metrics.Total Merchant Deposit: Positive posted topup ledger entries across all merchants. Pending requests, rejected requests and withdrawals are excluded.
metrics.Registered Merchants: Count of businesses in the merchant registry. Citizen accounts and profile TINs do not contribute.

periods.dashboard: All time; wallet is current balance. Chart period changes only the chart.
periods.monitor: Today in Asia/Manila through response generation. Database bounds respect the configured application timezone. Stream filters and pagination do not change Today cards.

security: Financial summary is available only to admin/super_admin. BIR monitor users retain existing access without platform fee totals. Merchant/citizen dashboards return no global financial summary.
environment: Live only. Separate sandbox events do not contribute to financial widgets.
mutations: None. No repricing, backfill, fee debit, wallet credit, schema change or test sale.

verification.build: Laravel, document renderer and static builds passed
verification.visual: Actual dashboard and monitor components checked with synthetic fixtures before deployment
